adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` where, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, it performs a `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams(...) })` with no `AbortSignal`/timeout and no retry/backoff. This is a concrete resilience concern introduced by the change because multiple integrations now route token refresh through this function, so a slow/hung customer endpoint can block those flows. However, the diff does not show an explicit correctness failure (it depends on endpoint behavior and runtime), so it’s better classified as a robustness/architecture issue rather than a definite bug.
